title: Row conditions on read grants
why: A public read served every row, drafts included; a grant can now cover only matching rows, enforced as bound SQL. B0749 warns on an unconditioned public read of a resource with a state field.

adopt.snippet:
<meta server>
export default { read: [{ public: { where: { status: 'published' } } }, 'owner', 'admin'], create: ['admin'], update: ['owner', 'admin'], delete: ['admin'] }
